pr_title: Strip field descriptions to word limits, anti-parrot in call-2+, fix threshold
pr_description: Minimal field descriptions**: consequences `"Direct effect and one downstream implication (30–60 words)."`, options `"Exactly 3 options. Each is one sentence (15–25 words)."`, review_lever `"Critical review (20–40 words)."` — all redundant guidance removed, system prompt does the teaching Anti-parrot in call-2+**: Add `"Each review_lever must be a genuine critical assessment — not a restatement of the consequence."` to the subsequent-call prompt Minimal section 4**: `"A one-sentence critical review (20–40 words). Examples:"` — no copyable template System prompt section 2**: consequences target `30–60 words`, section 6 options `15–25 words` Fix partial_recovery threshold**: runner.py `< 3` → `< 2` Net -22 lines. Field descriptions stripped of everything the system prompt already says.
